workflowInput.requestedWork: Invert the hidden reusable style prompt, not the teacher image: extract and model transferable style factors, synthesize a self-contained text prompt, and optimize it on arbitrary source images. Never optimize pixel similarity or teacher subject, pose, crop, exact composition, objects, text, or scene.
acceptanceCriteria: style-model.json separates medium_rendering, palette_tone, line_shape, texture_material, and graphic_language from teacher-image content leakage and maps each dimension to prompt clauses.
The five reusable style dimensions contribute 70 percent of training loss and each satisfies the frozen per-style ceiling.
Pixel similarity and teacher subject, objects, text, pose, crop, exact layout, and scene are never scored as desired reconstruction targets.
The final prompt is self-contained text and requires no target or style-reference image at generation time.
Every candidate, validation, and test generation record contains exactly one source_reference image input.
The target/style truth path and SHA-256 never appear in generation input_images or generation calls.
The prompt contains zero training-source, teacher-content, or held-out-source hard-coded clauses.
Frozen validation and sealed test prove style transfer, source preservation, and optional pose, composition, and exact-text adherence on disjoint images.
All generation and judge models, prompts, hashes, style-vector components, and loss calculations are persisted.
constraints: Use repository-relative paths in persisted artifacts.
Use the built-in image generation tool.
Target/style truth is analysis-and-judge-only and forbidden as a generation input.
Do not open validationManifest before validate-transferability.
Do not open sealedTestManifest before audit-generalization.
Do not modify prior iteration evidence.
Do not compare style-inversion-v2 losses numerically with prior metric versions.
